portal_description:
This update adds the yelp-tools packages to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.

The yelp-tools packages contain a set of utilities to create, edit, manage, and publish documentation in Mallard or DocBook.

The mallard-rng packages provide RELAX NG schemas for all supported Mallard versions and extensions. The schemas are provided in both XML and compact syntax. The packages automatically integrate with the system's XML catalog.

The yelp-tools package has been updated to version 3.18.0. In addition this
update adds the mallard-rng package to Red Hat Enterprise
Linux 7.

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.4 Release Notes linked from the References section.
